title: Aurevane Lumisera Serum
description: Authentic AI-generated beauty and skincare testimonial commercial showcasing natural morning lighting, real creator pacing, and dewy radiant skin glow.
overview: Created an authentic, high-converting vertical UGC video advertisement featuring a natural beauty creator demonstrating the Lumisera facial serum, highlighting skin texture and immediate radiant glow.
challenge: Traditional influencer and studio UGC shoots take weeks to coordinate, suffer from inconsistent brand messaging, and cost upwards of $3,500 per video variant.
solution: Synthesized an authentic digital creator persona with natural speech cadences in ElevenLabs, generated fluid facial motion keyframes in Runway Gen-3, and composited photorealistic bottle typography and kinetic text overlays.
